rawContent: @JaimeHartless You’re completely right. The beginning of #MeToo press coverage was a series of stories about sexual harassment and assault at Fox News. Those stories set the stage for the widespread use of the hashtag—it was a problem from all sides of the aisle.

@JohannaMellis @JessicaCalarco I mean, look at the #MeToo movement right? There was such widespread support until victims started naming names. Then, the credible, compassionate victims turned into monsters trying to ruin the lives of “good guys.”
